ns0:svg.ns0:title: Ingestra - AWS serverless architecture
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Code-verified architecture. Solid arrows are synchronous requests or tasks. Dashed arrows start asynchronous Standard workflows. Runtime core is exported from docs/architecture.mmd.
ns0:svg.ns0:text: Preview-first inventory ingestion and conflict-aware recovery

ns0:svg.ns0:title: Ingestra - AWS serverless architecture
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Amplify serves the React browser app. The browser calls an API Gateway HTTP API and uploads directly to private S3. An API Lambda starts three separate asynchronous Standard Step Functions workflows. Preview chooses one of two validator Lambdas. Import and rollback use a shared worker and conditional transactions across three DynamoDB tables. Supporting services are IAM, CloudWatch Logs, DynamoDB-managed KMS encryption, and SAM/CloudFormation deployment with a separate S3 artifact bucket.

ns0:svg.ns0:text: CloudWatch Logs: 4 Lambda + 3 workflow groups; 14-day retention; workflow ERROR logging.
IAM: 7 runtime roles. KMS: AWS managed DynamoDB key. SAM / CloudFormation: backend deployment.
A separate S3 bucket stores SAM artifacts. Amplify hosting is outside the SAM stack.
Solid arrows: synchronous HTTPS / SDK / Lambda Tasks. Dashed arrows: asynchronous workflow starts (HTTP 202).
The preview failure handler also uses WorkerFunction. Response paths are omitted for clarity.
